      where griewank(x) =  1 + sum(x**2 / 4000) - prod(cos(x / sqrt(i)))
    - quartic_term = sum(i * x_i^4) / quartic_scale  + noise

    rotation_matrix = np.array([[ 0.707, -0.707,  0.   ,  0.   ],
